6.2.rationale_zh: 《健康從業人員能力保證法案》2003年專注於確保執業人員的能力，這與ISO 13485第6.2條關於人員能力的意圖一致。

6.3.rationale_en: The PECPR regulations cover the design and inspection of pressure vessels (e.g., autoclaves), which are critical pieces of infrastructure requiring specific safety standards.
